stories.title: Se mantiene 'Polo' estacionario frente a costas de México

en.title: 'Polo' remains stationary off Mexico's coasts
en.summary: Hurricane Polo, a category 5 storm, is holding its position approximately 345 kilometers south of Zihuatanejo, Guerrero and 570 kilometers southeast of Manzanillo, Colima.

stories.title: Fraudes financieros: de cada 9 mexicanos que confían reconocerlos, 6 terminan siendo víctimas

en.title: Financial fraud: out of every 9 Mexicans who trust they can recognize it, 6 end up being victims
en.summary: In Mexico, two-thirds of people who believe they can detect financial fraud become victims. The report examines why this occurs and recommends practices for preventing bank fraud.

stories.title: Bolsa mexicana avanza por segundo día consecutivo tras tocar su peor nivel en el año

en.title: Mexican stock market advances for second consecutive day after hitting its worst level of the year

stories.title: El Nasdaq marca récord, pero el IPC mexicano mantiene rezago y el peso ronda los 17.30 por dólar

en.title: Nasdaq hits record high, but Mexican IPC lags and peso hovers around 17.30 per dollar
